text:
Alex: Heads-up — I’m seeing an ~18% throughput regression on mixtral-8x MQA runs after the kernel-hint change. posting numbers and a tiny repro.
Maya: Hmm, saw higher tail latency on dedicated yesterday, could be batching heuristics interacting with KV layout :thinking: 
Sam: Can you paste the bench command + profiling output?
Alex: Repro command I used:
```bash
python bench/throughput.py --model mixtral-8x --mode mqa --batch-size 4 --seq 512 --kv-dims 128 --num-kv-heads 16 --runs 100
```
Alex: Quick profiling summary: kernel selection flipped from `fused-attn` -> `tiled_kv_gemm` for seq > 384 because our heuristic considered kv_stride misaligned. L2 miss rate up 2.3x, warp occupancy dropped. p2p memcpy spike on paged KV.
Maya: Are you accidentally setting num_key_value_heads != num_heads/2? Mismatch can cause padded KV layouts and kernel fallback.
Lina: Also RoPE scaling can change effective head_dim layout. if head_dim * rope_scale crosses 32/64 boundary we end up with different kernel paths. saw that with Llama->Mistral configs before.
Sam: Which kernel backend? cuBLAS or our fused kernels?
Alex: Our runtime w/ kernel_hints=v2 (fallback to tiled-kv when kv_stride%64!=0). Kernel debug snippet:
```
[DEBUG] kernel_select: fused_attention -> tiled_kv (reason: kv_stride 512 not aligned)
[PROFILE] L2_MISS_RATE: 0.12 -> 0.28
[PROFILE] warp_occupancy: 0.78 -> 0.56
[PROFILE] memcpy_kv_pages/s: 120 -> 420
```
Priya: This smells like paged-KV fragmentation after the slab allocator tweak — we observed extra memcpy overhead when small pages are scattered. fragmentation% jumped after the allocator change.
Maya: Quick mitigation: align kv dims to 64 and try num_key_value_heads=8 for mixtral-8x. that fixed a similar regression for me last quarter :thumbsup: 
Alex: Did a quick forced test: `--num-kv-heads 8 --kv-dims 128` -> throughput +21% and kernel stayed `fused-attn`.
Lina: Suggestion: add an auto-alignment pass in the compilation/runtime that rounds kv_stride up to 64 and biases kernel_select to prefer fused-attn when head_dim * num_heads maps nicely to warp lanes.
Sam: I drafted a perf PR (w/ bench artifacts + opt-in flag `--kv-align`) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4592 (draft). It adds `kv_stride_alignment` policy and updates batching heuristic to avoid tiled_kv for small paged fragments.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy runtime/v2.13.4 -> eng-runtime pool started at 2060012347.
Alex: Re-ran on canary with alignment flag enabled — tail latency looks better, overall throughput still ~3% lower for skewed seq distributions (lots of short+one long). need a deterministic nightly to catch that.
Priya: I’ll add a nightly benchmark matrix that runs GQA and MQA across seq=[64,128,512,1024], head_dim variants, and reports kernel_select heatmap + memcpy_s rate.
Maya: Also add RoPE-scale sanity checks — kernel_select should be stable across rope_scale in [0.75,1.25] for same effective head dim.
Sam: Will iterate on the PR, add the nightly config and a tiny regression test that fails if tiled_kv chosen when kv_stride aligned. thanks everyone.
